welcome.text: Welcome to Mouse Missions. Help your little mouse find the cheese.

pick.text: Pick up the cheese or key on this square.

open.text: Open the door in front of you with your key.

if-cheese.text: Is there cheese on this square?

if-key.text: Is there a key in my backpack?

if-left.text: Is the path to my left clear?

slot.text: Add the next block here. Tap a block to remove it.

retry.text: Reset Mouse. Your programme stays here.

win.text: You did it! Your programme worked in every garden.

bump.text: A gentle bump! Check which way Mouse is looking. Change a block and try again.

unfinished.text: Nearly there. Look at where Mouse stopped. You can change your programme and try again.

empty.text: There is nothing to pick up here. Try the paw on a cheese or key square.

door.text: Mouse needs a key and a door just ahead to open it.

reward.text: Mouse has levelled up! Choose something new. Tap a picture to see it, then tap the tick.

wardrobe.text: Your mouse collection. Choose anything you have earned.

help.text: Follow the pale footprints. The arrow shows which way Mouse is looking.

conditions.text: Use the pictured question in your programme. Watch the tick or cross to see what Mouse finds.

next-garden.text: Now let us try the same programme in the next garden.

complete.text: You finished every mission! You are a magnificent mouse programmer.

level-1.text: Mission 1. Give Mouse one forward step to reach the cheese.

level-2.text: Mission 2. Put two forward steps in your programme.

level-3.text: Mission 3. Three steps will cross the bridge.

level-4.text: Mission 4. Turn left on the spot. Then move forward.

level-5.text: Mission 5. Turn right on the spot. Then move forward.

level-6.text: Mission 6. Walk forward, turn, and go around the flowerpot.

level-7.text: Mission 7. Plan the two corners. The arrow shows where Mouse is looking.

level-8.text: Mission 8. Left, then right, then left. Build a zigzag route.

level-9.text: Mission 9. Plan the whole route to the picnic. You can take one step at a time.

level-10.text: Mission 10. One arrow is wrong. Tap it to remove it, then put a forward step in its place.

level-11.text: Mission 11. Walk two steps, turn left on the spot, then walk to the cheese.

level-12.text: Mission 12. This time the corner turns right. Watch the arrow on Mouse.

level-13.text: Mission 13. Plan a left turn and a right turn. Count the steps between the corners.

level-14.text: Mission 14. Follow the winding path. Turn right, then left, to reach the cheese.

level-15.text: Mission 15. Mouse starts looking up. Forward means the way Mouse is looking.

level-16.text: Mission 16. Take your time with three corners. You can try one step at a time.

level-17.text: Mission 17. One turn points the wrong way. Watch Mouse, then replace that turn.

level-18.text: Mission 18. One forward step is missing before the corner. Choose a plus and add it.

level-19.text: Mission 19. There is one forward step too many after the second turn. Remove it and try again.

level-20.text: Mission 20. Mouse needs another forward step before the corner. Tap a plus to choose where it goes.

level-21.text: Mission 21. There is one step too many. Remove the last arrow.

level-22.text: Mission 22. Find the wrong turn. Replace it with a left turn.

level-23.text: Mission 23. Try one step at a time. Find the extra forward step.

level-24.text: Mission 24. Stop on the key and use the little paw to pick it up. Then reach the cheese.

level-25.text: Mission 25. Pick up the key. Stop before the door and open it. Then walk through.

level-26.text: Mission 26. Pick up both little cheeses on your way to the picnic flag.

level-27.text: Mission 27. Collect the key, open the door, and collect the cheese before the flag.

level-28.text: Mission 28. The question block looks for cheese here. Put a paw inside its tick side, then move forward.

level-29.text: Mission 29. The same question works when there is no cheese. It skips the paw and carries on.

level-30.text: Mission 30. Use one programme for both gardens. Pick up cheese only when it is there.

level-31.text: Mission 31. The open path picture asks if the square ahead is clear. Move only when it is.

level-32.text: Mission 32. Check ahead first. If it is blocked, skip that step. Then turn right and walk.

level-33.text: Mission 33. Try both gardens. Sometimes there is an extra clear square before the right turn.

level-34.text: Mission 34. Collect the key. The key question checks your backpack before opening the door.

level-35.text: Mission 35. Use a cheese question at the start, and a backpack key question at the door.

level-36.text: Mission 36. Check for cheese. Check the path. Then turn right. Your programme must work in both gardens.

level-37.text: Mission 37. The fork has two sides. Clear ahead? Follow the tick. Otherwise, follow the cross.

level-38.text: Mission 38. The same decision works even when Mouse starts facing a different way.

level-39.text: Mission 39. Put two forward steps in the clear side. In the other side, turn right and walk.

level-40.text: Mission 40. Look to the left. If it is clear, turn left. Otherwise, turn right. Then walk.

level-41.text: Mission 41. Choose the open side, then walk two squares to the picnic.

level-42.text: Mission 42. If cheese is here, collect it. Otherwise, take a forward step. Then walk to the flag.

level-43.text: Mission 43. The two sides of the decision are mixed up. Swap the actions to help Mouse.

level-44.text: Mission 44. First check for cheese. Then check the path. Watch each question light up in all three gardens.

level-45.text: Mission 45. Use all your skills. Check for cheese, collect the key, open the door, then choose the clear route.
